After much deliberation, we have decided that the time has come to sell our 2023 AT Expedition 67 auto with pop top. Brilliant van which has served our family of two adults and two kids really really well with its 4 belted seats and 4 berths.
As well as all the Autotrail factory standards, it has the shower room window, factory cab blinds and a second leisure battery, as well as a diesel heater which we added last year for the Scottish winters. I have also added extra insulation and a few other mods to shelves etc. The main modification though is the fixed bed frame I added across the back, giving large garage space beneath for paddle boards etc, comfier mattress, and no bed to set up each night. Nothing is drilled or fixed in place, meaning this bed can be completely removed and returned to factory layout with the bench seats prior to sale, or included in the sale if preferred.
Absolutely everything works exactly as it should and whilst there are a few signs of use, most notably on the pop-top canvas, it's a very well looked after and much loved van.
It has been serviced regularly and had an oil change in August 2026 along with a full habitation check which I'm more than happy to share with serious buyers.
I'm happy to arrange a fresh MOT and professional detail and wax prior to sale if the advertised price is met. Very happy to answer questions, informal chats, viewings etc.

A brand-new VW T7 Transporter Commerce Pro with delivery miles, professionally converted by York Campervans using our new ventyr Plus conversion package.
Designed for those wanting a modern, practical campervan with genuine off-grid capability, the ventyr Plus combines our contemporary campervan interior with a completely gas-free electrical system.

A 270W solar panel helps replenish the system while you're away, making this a fantastic setup for weekends away, touring and longer off-grid adventures.

The Devon Firefly is one of those campervans that makes you wonder why every van isn't designed this way. Based on the Ford Transit Custom, it gives you the driving manners and manageable dimensions of a car-derived van, but cleverly packs in everything you actually want when you disappear for the weekend — including four travelling seats, a proper kitchen, a washroom and two comfortable single beds.
And that's really the Firefly's appeal. It's a campervan you can genuinely use as an everyday vehicle, rather than something that only comes out when you're going away. At around 5 metres long, it remains remarkably easy to drive and park, while the 2019 Euro 6 Transit Custom gives you a modern, refined base vehicle with plenty of performance.
Inside, Devon's clever rear-kitchen layout makes excellent use of the space. The kitchen runs across the back of the van and provides a surprisingly generous amount of worktop, with a two-burner hob, sink and plenty of storage, while the clever built-in recesses for plates and mugs are a lovely example of Devon's attention to detail. Depending on the specification, there's also an oven/grill and either an 80-litre compressor fridge or three-way fridge.
Opposite the kitchen is something you don't always expect to find in a campervan this compact — a proper washroom with cassette toilet and privacy screen. It's a hugely useful feature, particularly when you're wild camping, travelling with children or simply don't fancy making a midnight dash

At Rove Motorhomes, we are delighted to offer quality campervans and motorhomes that combine premium build quality, thoughtful design and genuine touring practicality, and the HYMER Free range is an excellent example of this approach. Developed around the dependable Fiat Ducato platform, the Free range provides the freedom and manoeuvrability of a panel van while incorporating the essential comforts needed for touring. The HYMER Free 600 Campus (2020) is a particularly desirable special edition, combining its distinctive two-tone styling with a generous specification, including a pop-top roof, 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control and a 140bhp Fiat Ducato engine. Measuring approximately 5.99m in length, 2.08m in width and around 2.70m in height, it has a maximum permissible mass of 3,300kg, with 3,500kg available as an option, making it an extremely versatile campervan for both everyday driving and longer adventures.
Starting at the rear of the campervan, the Free 600 Campus features a clever rear sleeping and storage area. The rear bed can be folded upwards when not required, opening up valuable space for luggage, outdoor equipment and other touring essentials. When it's time to settle down for the evening, the bed provides a generous and comfortable sleeping area, making excellent use of the vehicle's compact footprint. The rear section also benefits from useful storage solutions, allowing you to carry everything you need without compromising the living space.

Swift Carrera 184 LWB 2.2 Auto - Wheelchair Accessible
Owned by us from new and very well cared for.
We are selling our Swift Carrera 184 LWB 2.2 Auto, which has been exceptionally well looked after and is in excellent condition.
It has been specifically and professionally adapted as a wheelchair-accessible motorhome, making it ideally suited to anyone who requires wheelchair access when travelling and enjoying holidays away.
The vehicle has been professionally converted by the supplying dealer, including a side wheelchair lift to allow easy access into the vehicle, along with a number of carefully considered internal modifications to make manoeuvring a wheelchair inside much easier.
A professionally fitted hoist is also installed, allowing a passenger to be transferred from the front passenger seat through to the rear of the vehicle and into the bathroom. The whole setup has been designed to make travelling with someone who requires wheelchair access as straightforward and comfortable as possible.
Expensive Optional Extras Include:
* Rear TV
* Habitation Air Conditioning
* Roll-out Canopy Awning
* Solar Panel
* Reversing Camera
* Professionally fitted wheelchair side lift
* Professionally fitted passenger transfer hoist
* Additional internal modifications for wheelchair manoeuvrability
This is a fantastic, well-equipped motorhome that is ready to use, particularly for anyone looking for a vehicle that has already been professionally set up for wheelchair accessibility.

The Kia PV5 is one of the most talked-about compact electric vans to be launched in recent years—and it is easy to see why.
Many electric vehicle brands are still relatively unknown, but everyone knows Kia. The PV5 comes with Kia’s renowned seven-year warranty, offers an excellent driving range and is compact enough to use as an everyday vehicle. It looks fantastic, drives superbly and costs thousands of pounds less than many comparable electric vans.
If you haven’t driven a Kia PV5 yet, we recommend taking one for a test drive—you may be very pleasantly surprised!

When connected to the campervan mains hook-up, the system will also be capable of slow-charging the vehicle battery.

With just 145 miles from new, this 2026 VW Transporter T7 Freedom is essentially unused. Finished in bold Intense Red with a colour-coded roof and 16" Steel wheels, it makes a genuinely striking impression. On the road you'll benefit from air conditioning, cruise control, rear parking sensors, a reverse camera, Bluetooth, and App Connect for a relaxed, confident drive.
Contact CamperKing today to arrange a viewing or discuss finance on this exceptional, virtually new T7 Freedom.

The 2017 Westfalia Kepler One is a compact, high-quality campervan based on the Volkswagen T6 Transporter, often praised for blending the versatility of a daily driver with the amenities of a motorhome, including a rear wet room. It is a 4-berth, 4-seatbelt vehicle featuring a pop-top roof, L-shaped seating, and a fully equipped kitchen, generally powered by a 2.0L diesel engine.
Key Features and Performance
Dimensions: At approximately 5.3 meters long, it offers a more spacious interior than a standard VW California while still being compact enough for easier parking compared to larger motorhomes.
Living Space: Features a unique layout with L-shaped seating, a sliding table, and a rear kitchen/bathroom area.
Kitchen: Equipped with a two-ring hob, sink, and a 40–50 liter fridge.
Bathroom: A standout feature is the rear wet room, which includes a fixed or portable cassette toilet and a shower tray, allowing for indoor, albeit compact, showering.
Bedroom: A pop-top roof provides an upper bed, while the lower seating area converts into a second bed.
Heating: Usually equipped with Webasto diesel heating and a Truma hot water boiler.
Pros
Bathroom in a small van: The inclusion of a shower and toilet is highly rated for a van under 5.5 meters.
High-quality build: Generally features premium, durable Westfalia workmanship.
Comfortable driving: Based on the VW T6 with options for automatic DSG gearbox.
Storage: Offers ample storage for a vehicle of its size, including a rear wardrobe.

The Fairford has beds and seatbelts for four. It’s the same overall length as the Warwick XL and also has a rear lounge, but this time there’s a second seating area up front. Most of the Fairford’s rivals adopt a half-dinette arrangement for the forward lounge, but here it’s pullman-style with forward and rearward-facing benches on either side of a wall-mounted table.
At the back, the rear lounge is obviously more compact than in the two-berth Warwick models but this is still a cosy and comfortable place in which to relax. You can also dine here, adding one or both of the small tables that store behind the settees’ backrests. Then, at night, the two sofas pull together to create a transverse double bed. Of course, the front lounge converts into a second double bed, leaving room for one person to stand by the sliding door and a slightly larger area between the washroom and galley.
Opposite the culinary area, you’ll discover the ablutions behind a sliding tambour door. Here, the washbasin can slide along a rail to a position above the cassette toilet to create more room for showering.

The rear lounge of the Warwick XL is a marvel to behold. The two long bench seats provide the perfect lounge for dining and relaxing and the convesion into two long singles or a massive double is quick and easy. There is a choice of two tables.
You’ll get a good night-time blackout thanks to fitted blinds on the cab windows.
By any stretch of the imagination, this is a well-equipped kitchen for a van conversion. It kicks off with a Thetford Triplex cooker – three-ring gas hob with combined oven and grill – and is supplemented by a Dometic microwave oven. The latter is at the opposite end of the kitchen, set at eye-level height over the fridge – a Thetford model which features automatic energy selection.
There’s a good amount of worktop space – permanent and to the left of the sink (where you’ll also find mains and USB sockets, plus a kitchen roll holder), while over on the right is a short, flip-up extension. Lighting is in the extractor unit as well as underneath the microwave.
Like the rest of this conversion, the washroom isn't lacking for high spec equipment. It’s almost a room of two halves. Just inside the door is a swivel-bowl toilet, with an opening window beyond and there’s a well-proportioned shower cubicle which has a small hand basin within it.

The Etrusco CV 640 PB is a 6.36-metre camper van designed for flexible touring, combining compact external dimensions with a smart, adaptable interior. Built on a Fiat Ducato chassis, it offers a good balance between everyday drivability and comfortable living for longer trips.
Finished in Expedition Grey, the exterior has a clean, modern appearance, while the interior trimmed in Emilia cloth provides a practical and comfortable living space with a contemporary feel.
A standout feature of this model is the electric height-adjustable rear double bed, which significantly enhances versatility. The bed can be raised or lowered as needed, allowing the rear area to be adapted for different uses. When lifted, it creates a large garage space capable of accommodating bicycles or even a small motorbike, making it ideal for active travel and outdoor gear. Lowering the bed restores a comfortable sleeping area without requiring any complex setup.
The layout includes a transverse rear bed area, a central kitchen with hob, sink, and fridge, and a compact washroom with toilet, basin, and shower. At the front, swivelling cab seats integrate with the dining area to form a sociable lounge space.
Storage is well distributed throughout, with overhead lockers and cleverly designed compartments that maximise usable space. Overall, the CV 640 PB offers a practical, modern camper van solution, with the added benefit of a configurable rear garage thanks to the electric raisable bed—ideal for transport

The Malibu Relax 640 LE R from Malibu is a well-built campervan based on the Fiat Ducato, designed for comfortable touring while staying compact at around 6.4 m in length.
Inside, it has a practical layout with two single beds at the rear that can be used separately or combined. The middle section includes a compact kitchen and a washroom with a space-saving shower, while the front lounge provides a seating and dining area. The layout allows easy movement through the van without needing to constantly convert spaces.
The main systems are simple to operate, with a central control panel for water, power, lighting, and heating. It includes onboard fresh and waste water tanks, a leisure battery, and a Truma heating system that provides both warmth and hot water, making it suitable for use in different seasons.
Storage is one of its key strengths. There are deep kitchen drawers, overhead lockers, under-bed compartments, and additional storage built into the floor. The rear area offers enough space for larger items, making it practical for longer trips.
The exterior is usually finished in white, giving it a clean and understated look. An awning is typically optional but commonly fitted, creating a sheltered outdoor area. A TV bracket can also be installed inside, usually near the lounge, with a swivel arm so the screen can be viewed from both the seating area and the rear beds.
Overall, it offers a good balance of comfort, storage, and ease of use in a manageable campervan size.

Used 2022 Auto-Sleeper Fairford Plus – Rear Garage, Air Suspension & Solar
The 2022 Auto-Sleeper Fairford Plus (Reg: PO22CFM) is an incredibly versatile 4-berth van conversion based on the extra-long wheelbase (6.36m) Peugeot Boxer chassis.
Powered by a robust 2.2L turbo diesel engine producing 160 bhp and paired with a 6-speed manual transmission, it has covered just 13,700 miles. This specific model benefits from an upgraded MTPLM of 4250kg and is fitted with rear air suspension, giving you a massive payload capacity and a superior driving experience. It comes exceptionally well-equipped for off-grid touring, featuring a roof-mounted solar panel, an underslung 25L LPG tank, and SG Pro Wi-Fi.
features: BENEFITS ✔ Upgraded Payload: The 4250kg MTPLM and rear air suspension provide massive carrying capacity for the rear garage.  ✔ Off-Grid Ready: Solar panel and underslung 25L LPG gas tank free up interior space and keep you powered up.  ✔ Versatile Layout: Rear section switches effortlessly between a transverse double bed and a large cargo garage.  ✔ Smart Tech: Stay connected with SG Pro Wi-Fi and Zenec Apple CarPlay/Android Auto navigation.  ✔ Travel Safely: 4 belted travel seats ensure family and friends can join the journey.

EXTERIOR & TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS Off-Grid Capabilities: Fully prepared for wild camping with a factory-fitted solar panel (80W-100W), an underslung 25L LPG tank, a 69L fresh water tank, and a 40L waste water tank.  Cab & Driving: The cab features an integrated Zenec touchscreen media console boasting satellite navigation, DAB radio, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay/Android Auto compatibility, and a reversing camera.  Outdoor Living: Enjoy the outdoors in any weather with both side and rear Thule wind-out awnings, external BBQ and TV points, and longitudinal roof bars for extra gear.
Extras Fitted: Rear Air Suspension, Underslung 25L LPG Tank, Solar Panel, SG Pro Wi-Fi, Zenec Sat Nav & Reversing Camera, Thule Side & Rear Awnings, External BBQ/TV Points, TV Mount.

INTERIOR HIGHLIGHTS Rear Lounge/Garage: Features a highly adaptable rear section that functions as a comfortable lounge, converts into a large transverse double bed, or folds away to create a massive garage area for bikes and sports gear.  Front Dinette & Travel: A smart front dinette that incorporates two additional forward-facing belted seats (making 4 travel belts in total) and converts into a second sleeping area.  Kitchen: A fully equipped central kitchen featuring a 3-burner gas hob, combined oven and grill, built-in microwave, an 81L fridge with a freezer compartment, and a clever pop-up "power tower" featuring three 230V sockets.

INTERIOR HIGHLIGHTS Washroom: A space-saving central wet room complete with a sliding washbasin, a swivel cassette toilet, and a handheld shower that doubles as the basin tap.  Technology & Finish: Stay connected with the installed SG Pro Wi-Fi (SIM required). Features high-quality Limewash Oak furniture, removable carpets, a built-in heating system, and a fitted TV mount.

details.description:
If you’re looking for a campervan that’s easy to drive but still feels comfortable to live in, the Bailey Endurance E62 is well worth a closer look.
At just under six metres, it’s manageable on the road and simple to park, but step inside and it doesn’t feel tight or restrictive. For couples who want flexibility without jumping up to a larger motorhome, this layout makes a lot of sense.
Up front, the lounge area is light and sociable with swivel cab seats and a flexible table set-up. It’s a space you’ll actually use, morning coffee, planning the next stop, or just putting your feet up after a long walk.
At the rear, the lounge converts into a generous double bed. It’s straightforward to set up and doesn’t involve complicated mechanisms. You can leave it made up if you prefer, or keep the space open during the day. It’s practical, and sometimes practical wins.
The kitchen gives you what you need for real touring. There’s a 90-litre compressor fridge that performs well off grid, a two-ring gas hob, sink and sensible storage. Opposite, the compact washroom includes a proper onboard shower and electric flush toilet. It’s designed to be usable rather than decorative.
Where the Endurance range really stands out is its year-round capability. With Grade III insulation, Truma heating and hot water, solar support and twin leisure batteries, this is a campervan you can use beyond summer weekends. Early spring breaks and autumn trips feel just as realistic.
